newsitem.title: IRAQ: Iraq's Saddam, wife and son appear on television.
newsitem.headline: Iraq's Saddam, wife and son appear on television.

text.p: Iraqi television on Tuesday showed President Saddam Hussein and his wife Sajida -- claimed by a U.S. military official to be under house arrest -- receiving well-wishers on the recovery of their son Uday.
Uday, who was shot and wounded in an attack in Baghdad on December 12, was sitting on a wheel-chair, the first time he has been shown out of his hospital bed.
A television announcer said both Saddam and his wife received members of the Iraqi Women's Federation, which congratulated them on the "safety and the full recovery" of their son.
He said the women had come to Ibn Sina hospital where Uday is being treated.
A senior U.S. military official said last week Saddam had put his wife under house arrest and his son might lose a leg to gangrene.
The official gave no details on when or why Saddam's wife might have been restricted but suggested the shooting attack on Uday might have prompted the decision.
